heading: Frequently asked questions about cosmetic surgery in Girona

items.q: What is the difference between cosmetic surgery and aesthetic medicine?
items.a: Cosmetic surgery is a surgical procedure performed in an operating theatre by a registered plastic surgeon (breast augmentation, liposuction, rhinoplasty, abdominoplasty or blepharoplasty), with long-lasting results and a recovery period. Aesthetic medicine covers non-surgical treatments, such as botulinum toxin, fillers, thread lifts or peels, which are done in the consulting room and let you get back to your routine the same day. At Medics Integral Salut we offer both with the same medical team.

items.q: How do I choose a good aesthetic clinic in Girona?
items.a: Check three things before deciding: that the surgeons are registered and accredited by societies such as SECPRE, that the clinic has a track record and verifiable reviews, and that the first visit is a real medical assessment, not a sales pitch. items.q: How much does cosmetic surgery cost and can it be financed?
items.a: The price of cosmetic surgery depends on the technique, theatre time, type of anaesthetic and aftercare, so there is no single fee: the quote is fixed in writing after the medical consultation, with no surprises or hidden costs. We offer financing to spread the cost in instalments, and the first consultation is always free and with no commitment.

items.q: What does the first consultation include and how do I book?
items.a: The first consultation is free and includes a review of your case with the specialist doctor, an explanation of the cosmetic surgery or aesthetic medicine options that suit you, answers to your questions about recovery and a fixed quote.
